participation.context: Named, and not yet in receipt of the paper.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

participation.context: Thanked, and told not to begin on the Avon.
participation.name: Hamnet Shakespeare

participation.context: Named in the lines you struck, and not sent.
participation.name: Samuel Daniel

story.body: You kept the brook and the plain part, struck the story that was for strangers, and put no sum on the page.

title: Wrote the word likely and crossed out the supper-story

participation.context: Read the line, and left the sum unwritten.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the word you were sending and did not open the money under the lid.

title: Read the word likely on the letter

participation.context: Spoke the word and shut the lid.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the word whole, and you shut the coffer.

title: Shut the coffer lid on the word likely
